title: Vitess: cluster status (keyspace, shards, tablet types)
description: The future nexus-cli VitessAdapter `status` verb -- prints the keyspace `commerce`, both shards (-80 / 80-), and each shard's tablet types (1 PRIMARY + 2 REPLICA) by reading the topo via vtctldclient over gRPC mTLS. Read-only; safe to run anytime.

observe.what: table: keyspace=commerce; shard -80 -> {nexus-100 PRIMARY, nexus-101 REPLICA, nexus-102 REPLICA}; shard 80- -> {nexus-200 PRIMARY, nexus-201 REPLICA, nexus-202 REPLICA}
sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-vtctldclient GetTablets --keyspace commerce -- the raw source the verb wraps
vtctld UI shows the same shard/tablet map

whatProves: The VitessAdapter reads cluster topology via vtctld gRPC mTLS and renders a one-shot health view -- the input to every other verb (failover-test, scale-out).
